title: Jubilant Saudi Arabian Date Kebabs
description: A pungent and snappy Saudi Arabian dish featuring candied peel, this festive recipe is perfect for any occasion, and is satvik-friendly to boot.
instructions: Soak the dates in water for 30 minutes to rehydrate them.
Preheat a non-stick skillet or griddle over medium heat.
In a blender or food processor, blend the dates, candied peel, almond flour, cardamom powder, and salt until a smooth paste forms.
Using your hands, shape the paste into small kebab-like shapes.
Brush the coconut oil onto the kebabs to prevent sticking.
Place the kebabs on the preheated skillet or griddle and cook for 2-3 minutes per side, until lightly browned.
Serve the kebabs hot in a copper mug, garnished with additional candied peel if desired.
Allow the kebabs to rest for a few minutes before serving to allow the flavors to meld together.
